an4.163:2.1: Katamā ca bhikkhave dukkhā paṭipadā dandhābhiññā?
an4.163:2.2: Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu asubhānupassī kāye viharati āhāre paṭikkūlasaññī sabbaloke anabhiratasaññī sabba saṅkhāresu aniccānupassī
an4.163:2.3: maraṇasaññā kho pan' assa ajjhattaṃ sūpaṭṭhitā.
an4.163:2.4: So imāni pañca sekhabalāni upanissāya viharati--saddhābalaṃ
an4.163:2.8: so imesaṃ pañcannaṃ indriyānaṃ muduttā dandhaṃ ānantariyaṃ pāpuṇāti āsavānaṃ khayāya.
an4.163:2.9: Ayaṃ vuccati bhikkhave dukkhā paṭipadā dandhābhiññā. 3.
an4.163:3.1: Katamā ca bhikkhave dukkhā paṭipadā khippābhiññā?
an4.163:3.2: Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu asubhānupassī kāye viharati āhāre paṭikkūlasaññī sabbaloke anabhiratasaññī sabbasaṅkhāresu aniccānupassī
an4.163:3.3: maraṇasaññā kho pan' assa ajjhattaṃ sūpaṭṭhitā hoti.
an4.163:3.4: So imāni pañca sekhabalāni upanissāya viharati--saddhābalaṃ . . .
an4.163:3.8: imesaṃ pañcannaṃ indriyānaṃ adhimattattā khippaṃ ānantariyaṃ pāpuṇāti āsavānaṃ khayāya.
an4.163:3.9: Ayaṃ vuccati bhikkhave dukkhā paṭipadā khippābhiññā. 4.
an4.163:4.1: Katamā ca bhikkhave sukhā paṭipadā dandhābhiññā?
an4.163:4.2: Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu vivicc' eva kāmehi vivicca akusalehi dhammehi . . . pe . . . paṭhamajjhānaṃ upasampajja viharati,
an4.163:4.3: vitakkavicārānaṃ vūpasamā . . . pe . . . dutiyajjhānaṃ upasampajja viharati,
an4.163:4.4: pītiyā ca virāgā . . . pe . . . sukhañ ca kāyena paṭisaṃvedeti yan taṃ ariyā ācikkhanti, upekhako ca satimā sukhavihārīti tatiyajjhānaṃ upasampajja viharati,
an4.163:4.5: sukhassa ca pahānā dukkhassa ca pahānā pubbe va somanassadomanassānaṃ atthagamā adukkhamasukhaṃ upekhāsatipārisuddhiṃ catutthajjhānaṃ upasampajja viharati.
an4.163:4.6: So imāni pañca sekhabalāni upanissāya viharati--saddhābalaṃ . . .
an4.163:4.10: imesaṃ pañcannaṃ indriyānaṃ muduttā dandhaṃ ānantariyaṃ pāpuṇāti āsavānaṃ khayāya.
an4.163:4.11: Ayaṃ vuccati bhikkhave sukhā paṭipadā dandhābhiññā. 5.
an4.163:5.1: Katamā ca bhikkhave sukhā paṭipadā khippābhiññā?
an4.163:5.2: Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu vivicc' eva kāmehi . . . paṭhamajjhānaṃ upasampajja viharati, . . . pe . . . dutiyajjhānaṃ upasampajja viharati, . . . pe . . . tatiyajjhānaṃ upasampajja viharati, . . . pe . . . catutthajjhānaṃ upasampajja viharati.
an4.163:5.3: So imāni pañca sekhabalāni upanissāya viharati--saddhābalaṃ . . .
an4.163:5.7: imesaṃ pañcannaṃ indriyānaṃ adhimattattā khippaṃ ānantariyaṃ pāpuṇāti āsavānaṃ khayāya.
an4.163:5.8: Ayaṃ vuccati bhikkhave sukhā paṭipadā khippābhiññā.
